turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hi Sofia! Happy Friday. How is your afternoon going in Phoenix? Are you done with your shift at the clinic?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hi! Yes, I just finished up a little while ago. I actually took the city's light rail line back home today instead of driving.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Oh, nice! It's always good to let someone else do the driving, especially after a long shift. Did you do anything to pass the time during the ride?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I did. I put on my headphones and listened to one of those Italian language learning podcasts.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That's a great way to practice! How is the Italian learning coming along so far?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It's slow but I'm making progress. Oh, and before I left the house this morning, I prepared a whisked green tea powder drink with hot steamed milk.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds delicious and energizing. Did you use your roommate's new espresso machine to steam the milk for it?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I did! The steam wand on that machine is amazing. It makes the milk so frothy.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: I'm glad you're getting some use out of it! Have you had any time for your sourdough baking lately, or has work been keeping you too busy?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I haven't baked since I got over the flu, but my starter is still healthy. I'm actually planning to feed it tonight and bake a loaf this weekend.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: There's nothing quite like fresh sourdough. I hope the bake goes well! Was the clinic pretty hectic today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It was a bit busy with patient appointments, but nothing we couldn't handle. I'm just ready to relax with Tom tonight.
